title: Windows Failed Logon Burst by Source
description: Alert-ready search for more than 10 Security Event 4625 failures from one source address in the five-minute scheduled-search window.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' = '4625' | stats count as FailedLogons by 'Source Address', 'Target User Name', 'Host Name (Server)' | where FailedLogons > 10 | sort -FailedLogons
